verdict.rationale: GlitchTip's own docs say hosted users can delete all their data by deleting their organization and user, which covers deletion only at a coarse, all-or-nothing level. No configurable retention periods or granular event/issue deletion controls are documented. Sample-rate settings reduce what gets collected rather than controlling retention, and the EU region and BAA address residency and compliance, not retention or deletion, so none of these earn credit. missing for 10: configurable retention windows, granular per-project/per-event deletion, programmatic (API/MCP/CLI) deletion controls, independent corroboration.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can control data retention and deletion

citations.quote: Hosted GlitchTip users have full control over their data and can delete it all when they delete their organization and user.
